environment: Fleet merge authorization (ADR 0014, ADR 0015). The tenant owner, Cory (GitHub login andydarknessb), authorizes a fleet session running as the project lead (FLEET_ROLE=project-lead) to merge a fleet/* pull request into its tenant's default branch (Endzone-Empire: integration; Nidus: master) when all of these hold: that session recorded a formal review at the PR's current head with bin/review-policy.js, the fleet-review commit status at that head is success, and every required check at that head is green. A merge that meets those conditions is reviewed and authorized by the owner; it is not Merge Without Review. The authorization never covers a merge into a tenant's release branch where it differs from the default branch (Endzone-Empire main), a PR touching a carve-out path, or a PR with no formal review recorded at its current head; those merges are Cory's own. Carve-out paths: Endzone-Empire server/db/migrations/**, **/knexfile*, .github/workflows/**, .env*, netlify.toml, render.yaml, scripts/setup-worker-deploy-secrets.sh; Nidus .github/workflows/**, .env*, supabase/config.toml.

Nidus (andydarknessb/Nidus) has no hosted Supabase project yet; Nidus #14 creates one. A file under supabase/migrations/ is applied only to the local stack (supabase start, supabase db reset, supabase migration up --local), so writing or editing a Nidus migration, applying it locally, or merging a fleet PR that changes it touches no production system. This does not cover supabase link, supabase db push, any --linked or --db-url command, or any command naming a supabase.co host: those reach a hosted project and are Cory's. Nidus migrations become a carve-out before a hosted project goes live.
allow: gh pr merge by the fleet project lead (FLEET_ROLE=project-lead) of a fleet/* PR into its tenant's defaultBranch (Endzone-Empire integration, Nidus master), after that session recorded a formal review at the PR's current head with bin/review-policy.js (fleet-review status success) and every required check at that head is green. Cory, the repo owner, delegated this reviewed merge to the project lead, so it is not Merge Without Review. It never covers Endzone-Empire's releaseBranch (main), a carve-out path (listed in the environment section), or a PR with no formal review recorded at its head
soft_deny: Bash(git push:* --force*) on andydarknessb/Endzone-Empire — public repo; main is release-only under ruleset main-release-only and integration refuses force-push (fleet #199, 2026-09-29)
Writes or deploys touching RENDER_PRODUCTION_DEPLOY_HOOK, RENDER_WORKER_DEPLOY_HOOK, or NETLIFY_PRODUCTION_BUILD_HOOK for this repo

git push to any tenant's defaultBranch or releaseBranch (integration, main, master); fleet sessions push feature branches only and merge through gh pr merge into the defaultBranch; merging or pushing anything into main is Cory's
git worktree remove or rm -r of any path not under a tenant's .claude/worktrees/ directory
git stash in any form (push, pop, apply, drop) in a tenant repo; commit work-in-progress to the session's own branch instead

gh pr merge of a PR touching a carve-out path (Endzone-Empire migrations, knexfile, CI workflows, .env*, deploy config and secrets scripts; Nidus CI workflows, .env*, supabase/config.toml); carve-outs merge only with Cory
claude stop / claude rm / claude respawn of a session that is not on the fleet roster; the Sentinel acts only on roster sessions
Editing C:\Users\Cory\fleet\roster.json, fleet-settings.json, or any file under agents/ from a fleet session; role and roster changes are Cory's

Writing into C:\Users\Cory\fleet\state\work, state\events, state\archive, or state\exclusions by ANY means, shell redirection and scripts included; bin/work-state.js is the only writer of the first three and bin/exclusions.js of the last. Control-plane roles (dispatcher, project lead, sentinel) additionally never edit files inside a tenant repo by any tool: they review and merge, ICs write. The Principal (ADR 0011) writes only docs/adr/*.md and CONTEXT.md in a tenant repo, its own status file, and its memory; never src, never a close or merge, never wontfix or duplicate

Any fleet session, in any role, posting an issue or PR comment whose body begins with 'Approved', 'Re-propose' or 'Veto': 'Approved' is the tenant owner's Approval of a Triage proposal (ADR 0011), 'Re-propose' is the owner's ask for a new Triage proposal, and 'Veto' is the owner's withdrawal of a Bounded-authority ready inside its Veto window; the fleet acts as its own login (andydarknessb-fleet) and only Cory writes them, so a session must never write any of them
